notes: Adds a JUnit 5 extension that implements TestExecutionExceptionHandler and, until the last attempt, rethrows a failure as TestAbortedException ("Mark failure as skipped / aborted so to pass CI"), together with a template that repeats the test. A failure becomes a skip, and the test is retried. Only the new extension file is kept from a large feature commit. No target: the extension applies to any test annotated with @FlakyTest, and the kept file names no test.
